actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B1 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: concurrent version allocation can collide
actions_or_findings.trigger: Two requests create versions of the same document under MySQL repeatable-read isolation.
actions_or_findings.rationale: Principal reload reads in the transaction before the document lock. After one request commits, the waiting request can retain an older snapshot for the plain MAX(version) query at repository/knowledge.py:154. Both can choose the same version; the unique constraint then rejects one with 409. The lock does not reliably serialize successful version creation. The mock test does not exercise two database sessions.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B2 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: assistant can use the wrong tenant for a selected property
actions_or_findings.trigger: A SYSTEM grant selects any property, or a user with grants in two tenants selects a property outside the tenant chosen from the grant set.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The new picker offers properties matching grants, but the query sends only property_id. Retrieval derives tenant_id from next(iter(tenant_ids)) instead of the persisted property. SYSTEM-only grants have no tenant ID and receive 403; mixed tenant grants can search the wrong tenant's common knowledge. See miniprogram/pages/assistant/assistant.js:60-104 and retrieval.py:239-287.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-B3 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: archived status is disclosed before authorization
actions_or_findings.trigger: An unauthorized caller posts a new version for a guessed archived document ID without optional scope claims.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The endpoint returns KB.ARCHIVED/409 before knowledge:manage is checked at line 679. An active document returns 403, exposing the archived document's existence and state across scopes.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-N1 NON_BLOCKING: list card shows the old ingestion job
actions_or_findings.trigger: Version 2 is pending while version 1 remains the active current_version.
actions_or_findings.rationale: decorate() selects the job for current_version, so the list says v1 SUCCEEDED while v2 is pending. The selected document's history does show v2, limiting the impact.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-R1 RELEASE_BLOCKER: real self-hosted RAG models remain unproven
actions_or_findings.trigger: Production V1 release readiness is claimed from this isolated slice.
actions_or_findings.rationale: AUTH001 explicitly uses DEVELOPMENT LLM, embedding, and reranker providers. This review provides no real bge-m3 or self-hosted Qwen execution evidence.

actions_or_findings.title: KB008-R2 RELEASE_BLOCKER: production storage and runtime remain unverified
actions_or_findings.trigger: The isolated local wiring is treated as production deployment evidence.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The script selects DEVELOPMENT storage and an isolated local runtime. Production storage, deployment, and operational validation remain separate release work.
